name: Summit Pizza Co. Bear Lake "Raspberry Doodles" (Seed Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City / Bear Lake & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: A famous Bear Lake specialty (swirled pizza crust stuffed with cream cheese and Bear Lake raspberries), but the whole raspberry seeds and cream cheese make it a remission-only treat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Swap to the Cinnadoodles or Skillet Cookie Sundae if you are avoiding berry seeds; otherwise eat 1–2 pieces with a Lactaid in steady remission.
watchOuts: Whole Bear Lake raspberry seeds in the filling
High lactose in cream cheese and frosting
